name: 18040 · Easton, PA
findings: ZIP 18040 (Easton) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (69%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18040 (Easton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
